workload.affinity: thread-count-only; operating-system scheduled for both engines
workload.warmup: one discarded engine-native warmup before each measured test
workload.thread_policy: per host_profile; identical for both engines within a run

apple_m1max.note: 8 performance cores; decode leaves one core to the OS

amd_9950x.note: 16 physical cores, SMT siblings excluded. Measured, not assumed: benchmark/results/THREAD-SWEEP-AMD9950X.md sweeps 4-32 threads and finds the joint optimum at 16 for both engines, with llama.cpp prefill collapsing ~6x under SMT. Decode uses 15 by the core-minus-one rule; that specific value sits on the 12-16 plateau but was not measured on its own.

pi5.note: 4x Cortex-A76, 4 GB reference board; decode leaves one core to the OS (same rule as apple_m1max). Thermals: active-cooling assumption; runner host gate handles load/settle.

temp_gate.note: passively cooled hosts (pi5) throttle at ~80C; measurements start below 62C so a full phase stays under throttle. Hosts without the sensor path skip this gate.
